Name: No Cooties
Author: ceruleandeep
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/9000/9000-1624619443-1207586121.png[/img][size=3][b]

﻿No Cooties[/b] turns those kisses from your spouse or roommate into friendly, platonic hugs. Don't risk catching cooties!

That friendly hug and happy smile you get from room-mate Krobus, you'll now get from any housemate(s).[/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/9000/9000-1624618350-415563824.gif[/img]﻿

[size=3][b]
[size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8711/8711-1620835492-419642025.png[/img][/size][/b]

Ideal for room-mates, platonic relationships, aromantics, or anyone who needs more hugs in their farm life.

Designed to increase immersion for people using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners and Friendships[/url].

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6227]Multiple Spouses[/url], more or less, because it [b]lets you hug anyone on your farm,[/b] married or not.

You can configure which characters are huggers, and which ones will kiss you and give you cooties.
[/size][size=3]

[/size][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8711/8711-1620835500-986425414.png[/img]﻿
